_comment: CANDIDATE, added 2026-09-24 to measure - not a recommendation. See docs/model-learnings.md.
Why try it: openai/gpt-6-luna lists at $0.10 in / $0.01 cached / $0.50 out per million -
cheaper than qwen/qwen3-coder on every line, with a 10x cache discount where qwen gets 3x.
Re-sent context is what cost $8.50 in one session, so the cache price matters most.
opus/fable also go to Luna: Claude Code's built-in Explore/Plan agents ask for them, so they are never just --model opus.
